statements.t: As we approach year-end, we remain confident in relcobatinib's potential to become a best-in-class therapy for patients with CML and are focused on executing our Phase 3 development program.”
The Company remains on track to initiate ENABLE-2 before year-end 2026.
The fireside chat will be webcast live and can be accessed by visiting the investor relations section of the Company’s website at https://ir.enliventherapeutics.com/ .
Cash position: As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaling $884.4 million, which is expected to provide cash runway into 2030.
